amdoc.exe - RainbowMiner AMD GPU overclocking helper for Windows
================================================================

amdoc.exe is a separate helper program shipped with RainbowMiner. It is built with the
AMD Device Library eXtra (ADLX) SDK and therefore contains code licensed to the
RainbowMiner project by Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. It is NOT covered by RainbowMiner's
GNU General Public License. amdoc.exe is licensed to you under the end user license
agreement below, as required by the ADLX SDK license. RainbowMiner only starts amdoc.exe
as an external program; removing the folder Includes\amdoc leaves RainbowMiner fully
functional, the AMD overclocking on Windows is then unavailable.

amdoc.exe talks to the AMD Adrenalin driver (amdadlx64.dll) on the local machine only
and may only be used together with AMD graphics products.
